canonical_purpose: Carry long-horizon software tasks through verified intermediate states so execution can branch, compare, and recover without replaying the entire trajectory.
intended_outcome: An execution system can persist verified subgoal checkpoints, branch from known-good states, compare divergent trajectories, and materialize a bounded recovery to a verified ancestor with exact provenance.
deployment_reason: Local-first execution/recovery developer tool; an always-on service is not required to fulfill the canonical purpose.
truth_boundary: Independent local-first execution/recovery system. No Cognition affiliation, proprietary integration, or production deployment claim is made. Captured checkpoints include tracked/untracked non-ignored worktree state and reachable Git history; purpose-specific external services require their own adapters if a workload depends on them.
receipt_binding: This receipt binds terminal status to the exact verified source SHA and successful workflow run above. The receipt-only commit must itself retain green verification before merge.
